name: Tessera TK-20 Apex 'Mandate'
description:
The Tessera TK-20 Apex is Tessera Corponation's flagship smart-linked combat pistol, chambered in 10mm Auto with full BCI integration, biometric authentication, and a proprietary predictive targeting system that begins calculating firing solutions before the shooter has consciously decided to fire. The weapon reads pre-motor cortex signals through the BCI link and begins ballistic computation during the 200-millisecond window between intention and action.

The Mandate is engineered for Tessera's most senior security operatives — individuals with military-grade BCI implants and years of neural-weapon integration training. The predictive targeting system is disorienting for inexperienced users; the weapon presents firing solutions for targets the shooter hasn't consciously identified yet, which can cause hesitation and confusion in operators without proper training. For trained users, the effect is seamless — the weapon feels like an extension of thought itself.

Tessera does not sell the Mandate commercially. Units are issued to qualifying personnel and recovered upon separation from service. The handful that have appeared on the black market command prices equivalent to a the Gray Zone apartment building, and Tessera's asset recovery teams pursue every one with notable determination.
legality: Corponation-restricted — not available for civilian purchase
specifications: caliber: 10mm Auto effective_range: 70 meters (smart-linked) rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic magazine_capacity: 12 rounds weight: 0.95 kg BCI_latency: <3ms predictive_window: 200ms pre-trigger
tactical_use: An elite smart-linked combat pistol with predictive targeting that reduces engagement time below human conscious reaction speed. The system identifies and presents firing solutions for threats before the operator's conscious mind has finished processing — effectively allowing the trained operator to shoot at the speed of instinct rather than deliberation. Requires extensive training to use effectively; untrained operators experience disorientation.
cultural_context: The Mandate is a myth to most of GLMZ. Its existence is known but its capabilities are exaggerated in street-level rumors — some claim it can fire autonomously, read minds, or target people through walls. The reality is impressive enough without embellishment. Among those who know the truth, the Mandate represents the current ceiling of neural-weapon integration technology.
story_hooks: A Mandate surfaces on the black market with its biometric lock intact — meaning someone has either cloned a senior Tessera operative's neural signature, or the weapon's owner is selling it while still employed. Either possibility has serious implications.

A Tessera operative's Mandate begins presenting firing solutions for their own colleagues — the predictive system is flagging friendlies as threats, and no one can determine whether it's a malfunction or if the AI knows something the operator doesn't.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purposeful combat pistol with aggressive angular lines and a forward-swept profile. The frame appears almost organic in its curves—designed to nestle into an augmented hand with neural-link ports visible along the grip spine. The slide has a distinctive forward cant, and the overall silhouette suggests predatory efficiency rather than traditional firearm aesthetics.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 21.5cm | Barrel: 10.2cm | Width: 3.8cm | Height: 13.7cm (including grip module)
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively light and balanced—0.95kg feels like holding compressed intention rather than mass. The weight distribution pulls slightly forward, encouraging the shooter's hand toward the target naturally. Despite its heft, it feels almost weightless to someone with military-grade cybernetic augmentation.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade titanium alloy frame with reinforced polymer grip module housing integrated neural interface contacts
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with brushed titanium accents. The slide bears a faint iridescent sheen—likely from a proprietary thermal-management coating. Grip spine shows subtle wear around the neural-link contact points where countless hands have gripped it.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep gunmetal gray primary with platinum and electric blue accent striping along the slide and magazine well. Neural-link contact pads glow a soft cyan when powered.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured synthetic grip with embedded neural-interface contact pads that feel like smooth, cold metal nodes integrated into the polymer. Faintly sticky to the touch—likely designed to interface with augmented skin or specialized gloves. Micro-ridges provide grip purchase while minimizing friction against augmented hands.
distinctive_features: Integrated BCI neural-link port on grip spine with recessed platinum contacts
Dual micro-LED status indicators (cyan and amber) embedded in the slide adjacent to rear sight
Minimalist sight package—integrated heads-up display relay rather than traditional iron sights
Proprietary Tessera ballistic-computing module visible as a slight bulge on the left slide
Magazine well shows faint etching: 'TESSERA CORPONATION | ASSET RECOVERY PROTOCOL'
Trigger guard slightly oversized—designed for gloved or augmented trigger fingers
Muzzle features a threaded suppressor mount with Tessera proprietary threading
Serial number (if present) would be laser-etched rather than stamped—reducing vibration signature
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Tessera Corponation logo—a geometric tessellating pattern—stamped subtly on the slide's left side just forward of the rear sight. Below it: 'TK-20 APEX | MANDATE | TIER-RESTRICTED ASSET'. The grip module bears a tamper-evident holographic seal that shifts between blue and red, indicating operational status.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly maintained. Units in the field show minimal wear due to restricted circulation and careful operator handling. Any black-market examples would show signs of desperate maintenance—improvised neural-link repairs, scratched contact pads, or crude attempts to circumvent the biometric lock. Official Tessera units are immaculate, treated as irreplaceable military hardware.
